SELECT c.id, c.content, u.name AS nickname, a.title AS articleTitle, c.page_key AS pageKey, c.ip, c.rid, c.is_pending AS pending, c.is_pinned AS pinned, c.is_collapsed AS collapsed, c.vote_up AS voteUp, c.vote_down AS voteDown, c.created_at AS createTime FROM re_article.atk_comments c LEFT JOIN re_article.atk_users u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN re_article.article a ON a.id = c.page_key
c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCondition}, '%')
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
